confirmed_facts.fact: Return requested 2026-11-02, 4.7 days after delivery; Return v2 applies with a 7-day electronics window, so the request is inside the window.
Dispatch serial SPK200-11842 matches the serial recorded at warehouse inspection; both the dispatch scan and the warehouse photo show the same serial.
Warehouse inspection found a sealed box, unused, all accessories present; received weight 1.11 kg versus dispatch 1.10 kg.
Refund amount calculated by code is AED 349 (item price only).

findings.description: Two PICKED_UP events for TRK-R2001, two minutes apart, record different weights (1.12 kg and 0.64 kg). The 1.12 kg value is consistent with dispatch and warehouse receipt weights and the warehouse photo, but no courier record explains the 0.64 kg re-scan, so it is not settled by evidence. The courier holds the answer.

evidence.quote: Sealed box, unused, all accessories present

policy_references.quote: The returned item must be the item sold: same SKU and, for serialised items, the same serial number as the dispatch record.
Missing evidence is requested from the party that holds it (seller, courier, warehouse or customer). Never assume what it would show.

findings.rationale: The return is inside the window, the serial matches, and the warehouse found the item sealed and complete. One courier conflict remains open: a second pickup event records 0.64 kg against 1.12 kg. A clarification request to the courier has been drafted for approval; the refund review can follow once it is answered.
findings.uncertainty_note: Most evidence supports an eligible return, but the duplicate pickup weight is unexplained until the courier responds. The 0.64 kg value is a signal, not proof of anything.
